{{Top|leg}}
A '''universal transceiver''' was a piece of communications equipment mounted aboard [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']] had a universal transceiver that allowed him to track [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacons]] through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].
